event1.label: CTA Clicks (e1)
event1.description: Increments every time a user clicks on a CTA button
event1.whenSet: When clicking on any call to action

event2.label: Link Clicks (e2)
event2.description: Increments every time a user clicks on a link

event3.label: Year Applied (e3)
event3.description: Increments every time a user selects year for PDF browsing

event4.label: Topic Applied (e4)
event4.description: Increments every time a user selects topic for PDF browsing

event5.label: Scroll Reach 25% (e5)
event5.description: Increments when a user reaches 25% of the page
event5.whenSet: When the the user reaches 25% scroll rate on any page

event6.label: Scroll Reach 50% (e6)
event6.description: Increments when a user reaches 50% of the page
event6.whenSet: When the the user reaches 50% scroll rate on any page

event7.label: Scroll Reach 75% (e7)
event7.description: Increments when a user reaches 75% of the page
event7.whenSet: When the the user reaches 75% scroll rate on any page

event8.label: Scroll Reach 100% (e8)
event8.description: Increments when a user reaches 100% of the page
event8.whenSet: When the the user reaches 100% scroll rate on any page

event9.label: Null Search (e9)
event9.description: Increments each time a search provides no results, allowing content managers to create content for terms users are searching
event9.whenSet: When a search provides no results

event10.label: Internal Search Click-through (e10)
event10.description: Increments each time the user clicks through search result pages ("Next page" button or arrows)
event10.whenSet: When performing a click to navigate through search results

event11.label: Error (e11)
event11.description: Increments each time a validation error is presented

event12.label: Page Load Time (e12)
event12.description: Captures the amount of time it takes for a page to load in milliseconds

event13.label: Video Start (e13)
event13.description: Increments each time a video is started
event13.whenSet: When clicking play to a video

event14.label: Video Complete (e14)
event14.description: Increments each time a video is completed

event15.label: Video 25% Milestone (e15)
event15.description: Increments each time a video is watched to the 25% milestone
event15.whenSet: When clicking a video reaches 25% reproduction

event16.label: Video 50% Milestone (e16)
event16.description: Increments each time a video is watched to the 50% milestone
event16.whenSet: When clicking a video reaches 50% reproduction

event17.label: Video 75% Milestone (e17)
event17.description: Increments each time a video is watched to the 75% milestone
event17.whenSet: When clicking a video reaches 75% reproduction

event18.label: Internal Search (e18)
event18.description: Increments every time a user does a search
event18.whenSet: When users perform a click that changes the results of a search

event19.label: Map Filter Applied (e19)
event19.description: Increments each time a filter item is un-checkmarked from map filter

event20.label: Click (e20)
event20.description: Increments every time you click on non-account buttons or link clicks
event20.whenSet: When user clicks a non CTA click nor Link click button

event23.label: Scroll (e23)
event23.description: Increments every time a scroll is performed

eVar2.description: The name of the previous page viewed on the site, which can provide insight to the page from which a user initiated a success event.

eVar3.description: The name of the page viewed on the site.

eVar4.description: The name of the site section viewed

eVar5.description: The name of the file downloaded

eVar6.description: The type of file downloaded (PDF, CSV, etc.)

eVar7.description: The number of search results provided from a search.

eVar8.description: Captures the name of the module the user is interacting with

eVar9.description: Captures the different types of search results pages (successful, no result, redirect, did you mean, etc.) Pull success events or exit rate into this report to understand how effective the search results pages are in assisting with conversion.

eVar10.description: Ability to view the page type (Home, Approach, Progress, Impact Areas, People, Reporting & Downloads, 2022 Report) visited by the user

eVar11.description: Ability to track the type of content that is being viewed (Video, Article, Slide show, Navigation Page, Gallery)

eVar12.description: Captures the CTA button a user clicks on (such as arrows for galleries and modules, icon on the home page, etc.)

eVar13.description: Captures the name of the video viewed on the site

eVar14.description: Captures the destination link (URL) of link clicks

eVar15.description: Capture the page’s URL without a query string using JavaScript on every server call. Answers what are the URLs where my events are triggered? What URLs correspond to a particular page name?

eVar16.description: Capture everything in the page’s URL after the ? (including any hastags #) on every server call in a prop and an eVar.  Answers what query string parameters are being set on a particular page name or page URL? Can also be helpful for segmentation

eVar17.description: Captures the redirect link that a user clicks on

eVar18.description: Captures the ECID. In testing, it's helpful to segment on a particular visitor ID to understand how data appears in reporting

eVar19.description: Captures the menu item a user clicks on

eVar20.description: Captures the year a user selects when browsing PDFs

eVar21.description: Captures the topic a user selects when browsing PDFs

eVar22.description: Captures the language the user selects for downloading PDFs

eVar24.description: Captures the term a user searches for

eVar25.description: Captures the sort by filter user selects

eVar26.description: Captures the selections for map filters (un-checkmarked) after user opens the filter menu

eVar27.description: Captures the menu item a user clicks on the header menu

eVar28.description: Captures the page section where the interaction takes place

eVar29.description: Captures the name of a click

eVar30.description: Captures type of result when users make a search

eVar31.description: Captures the URL up to the beginning of the utm parameters

eVar32.description: Captures the filter selected for document type

eVar33.description: When any page of the site is loaded

eVar34.description: When clicking on the social media icons to share an article

eVar35.description: Is added to the pageview hit and is used to identify Amazon Security test activity

eVar37.description: Used to identify tooltip interactions. Boolean value for Yes or No.

eVar40.description: Captures the industry by filter user selects

eVar47.description: Captures the type of error that interrumted the navigation

eVar49.description: Captures the filter selected for status type
